attBesluta.text: For the price it's fab. Seems sturdy so far. The lift top works well and easily even with stuff on top.
Ha sido muy buena compra y muy fácil de montar, es muy práctica para el uso diario

This cute table has changed our Friday movie nights! We love it! We’ll see if it outlasts two kids under 5, but for the price… it’s great. Super practical: they can open it as they please to access their games, crafts materials, etc.
Does what it says on the tin. Each panel is self standing so very good for splitting
Looks good easy to work with just for low traffic areas it's a vary thin product lots of coverage for the money

Easy to install over existing flooring in our class A RV. I did use some extra spray glue in high traffic areas. The last carton I ordered did not have the cutting lines on the back. I'm not sure if that's an issue to some. We'll see how the floor holds up. Big difference!
Easy to apply, look quite nice and durable. Would absolutely buy again
Beau produit. Un petit inconvénient, le fait qu'il soit difficile de faire arriver le motif d'une tuile à une autre. Sinon, très satisfaite du produit.

Just got this and filled it with heavy oak. I did put brick under the middle of each side as the weight max was probably under what I put on it. The cover is nice and thick and it is indeed water proof as it has rained everyday since I got it up and filled. I would recommend

J'utilise ce conduit pour isoler des gaines spiralées rigide, très pratique car facile a enfiler du fait que la taille soit légèrement plus grande que le conduit 2a 3cm de plus. Je n'utiliserais pas cette gaine pour conduire l'air directement car je la trouve quand même fragile mais parfait pour mon utilisation. petit plus enfiler une réduction sur la gaine spiralé pour passer cette isolant sans accroc.
